purpose: Teach: 貸し出し/同種/同業/各県/各党/引き継が/積み立て/役立て

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 店舗から機材の貸し出し、依頼が増えてる。
lines.en: We're getting more requests for equipment loans from the stores.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, efficient. No drama — just reporting what's happening. Direct eye contact. Pace steady and businesslike.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。同種の事案、まとめて対応します。
lines.en: Got it. I'll batch the similar cases and handle them together.
lines.style: Assured, responsive nod in the voice. Straightforward commitment — no need to over-explain. Warm enough to signal he's on the same page, not robotic.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 同業者の動き、目立つよね。
lines.en: The competition's movement is pretty visible right now.
lines.style: Observational, slightly weighted. Not alarmed, but noticing. Seeks confirmation — the 'よね' is checking if he's noticed too. Calm alertness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 各県の代理店、業績、共有しました。
lines.en: I've already shared the performance data from the prefecture distributors.
lines.style: Slightly proud of the groundwork. Clear and prompt — he anticipated what she'd want to know. Professional but warm, showing initiative.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 各党の政策動向、調査チームが纏める。
lines.en: The research team will consolidate the policy trends across all parties.
lines.style: Delegating with assurance. No micromanagement — confident in the team. Brisk but not cold. Moving the agenda forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 担当が引き継がれて、混乱もありません。
lines.en: The handoff is smooth — there's been no confusion.
lines.style: Reassuring progress report. Quiet pride in the execution. Steady rhythm. Shows he's thought ahead about potential friction points.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 積み立て年金、見直しを考えよう。
lines.en: Let's think about reviewing the pension reserves.
lines.style: Opening a new topic with collaborative language. Not a command — 'let's think' invites his input. Deliberate pace, slightly forward-leaning in tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経験を役立てて、新案、出します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll put forward new proposals drawing on what we've learned.
lines.style: Eager, confident close. Light emphasis on 'experience' — he's positioning this as growth from past work. Finishing note that suggests this won't be the last conversation on the topic.
